decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9718. Series context: trend strength 0.9538 and seasonal strength 0.4796; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.423); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.411.
